statement: Written before any 2024 to 2025 field-goal number was computed for this model.
The model was fitted on 2010 to 2021 only; the knot set was chosen by AIC on those seasons; 2022 to 2023 were used for checks only.
The test check runs once (--evaluate). Whatever it shows is reported, and the model does not change afterwards.

Post hoc: this model, the support distance and the cap or override it offers the planner were designed after seeing the world-model run on branch claude/world-model-colab (results/world_model/colab_t4_v2), whose simulated long-range make rate was above the raw training rate. They are not part of that run's preregistered plan.
The 2026 holdout has not been loaded.

scoring.season: each attempt's own season (the linear trend extrapolates from 2021)
scoring.comparison_model: M1 FieldGoalModel (distance and season trend), refitted on 2010 to 2021

hypotheses.statement: The hierarchical model (own kicker effects) has lower log loss than the M1 distance-and-season model on all 2024 to 2025 attempts.
Selection by kicker persists: among attempts by kickers seen in training, the mean training-estimated 50-yard strength of kickers on 55+ yard attempts exceeds that on all attempts.
The hierarchical model is calibrated within 5 points on 50+ yard attempts.
hypotheses.expectation: May fail toward under-prediction: the season trend is a straight line fitted through 2021, and long-range kicking may have improved faster since.

also_reported: log loss and Brier score for the hierarchical model with average-kicker effects
